question: Which among the following states does NOT produce coal in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gujarat is the only state among the given options that does not produce coal in India.**
 
• Gujarat has negligible reserves of coal and is not a significant contributor to coal production in India.
